sentences.text:
** **
Harkesh Manuja, J. (Oral)
[1].

By way of present petition filed under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, prayer has been made for issuance of direction to the learned Executing Court to decide the Execution No.825/2019 No. dated 17.09.2019 titled as 'Sat Sat Pal vs. State of Punjab'' within a time bound period.

entities.text: Sat Sat Pal vs. State of Punjab
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
[2]. 
Admittedly, certain land owned by the petitioner was acquired vide notification dated 20.11.2006 and 29.04.2007 issued under Sections 4 and 6 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short 'the 1894 Act') respectively, followed by an award dated 12.04.2008 passed by the Land Acquisition Collector,
whereby the petitioner was granted compensation to the tune of Rs.
Rs.10 lakhs per acre.
Feeling dissatisfied,, the petitioner (land owner) filed petition under Section 18 of the 1894 Act, which was decided by the Reference Court vide award dated 15.12.2010.

[3]. Aggrieved thereof, thereof the petitioner filed Regular First Appeal before this Court, which was disposed of vide order dated 27.01.2016 enhancing the compensation to the tune of Rs.21 Rs. lakh per acre acre.

Later the petitioner filed 1 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2025:PHHC:000687 Execution Petition No.825/ No. 2019 on 17.09.2019 before the learned Addl. District & Sessions Judge,
Sangrur and the same is now pending for 10.01.2025 and till date, the enhanced amount of Sat Pal vs State Of Punjab on 7 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121816148/
1 compensation has not been disbursed to the petitioner petitioner.

entities.text: Sat Pal vs State Of Punjab
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: [4]. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner being aggrieved of the non-disbursal non disbursal of amount of compensation have filed the present revision petition for issuance of direction rection to the Executing Court concerned to decide the execution application application expeditiously, in a time bound manner.
[5]. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the paper book.

[6]. A perusal of record shows that execution application (Annexure P-2) P filed by the petitioners on 17.09.2019 is still pending and the petitioner is waiting to get their amount of compensation on the basis of order dated 27.01.2016 passed by this Court.

In Rahul S. Shah vs. Jinendra Kumar Gandhi and others reported as (2021) 6 SCC 418 the Hon'ble Supreme Court held as follows:
follows:-
"That the executing Court must dispose of execution proceedings within 6 months from the date of filing which may be extended only by recording reasons in writing for such delay."

entities.text: Rahul S. Shah vs. Jinendra Kumar Gandhi and others reported as (2021) 6 SCC 418
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
[8]. In view of above, the Court of Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Sangrur (the Executing Court)
is requested to dispose of the Executing Petition No.825/2019 as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within a period of next 04 months from today, as any further further delay is going to cause serious prejudice to the rights of the petitioner.

entities.text: Court of Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Sangrur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: [9]. It is made clear that nothing said hereinabove shall be construed as an expression of opinion on the merits of the execution proceedings.
2 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2025:PHHC:000687 [10].
Petition stands disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
Pending application(s), if any shall also disposed of.
(HARKESH MANUJA)
